exposure: Trial of labor (TOL) after prior Cesarean delivery
cohort: Women with a prior Cesarean delivery.
finding: TOL after prior Cesarean delivery was associated with a higher risk of uterine rupture and endometritis but a lower risk of hysterectomy and neonatal respiratory problems compared to ERCD.
mod_finding: TOL after prior Cesarean delivery was associated with a higher risk of uterine rupture and endometritis but a lower risk of hysterectomy and neonatal respiratory problems compared to ERCD.
